info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status Retrieval API provides developers with the ability to access the current status of telecom SIM cards in batch. This API is essential for monitoring and managing SIM status across various applications, making it suitable for telecom companies, inventory management systems, and customer service platforms. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently retrieve essential status information for multiple SIMs, enabling proactive management and maintaining service quality. The API supports developers in integrating SIM status checks seamlessly into their systems.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the simulation.
get.description: This endpoint provides information about the current state of the simulation, including whether it is running, paused, or stopped. Use this to monitor the simulation's progress and health.
